tools.name: gatepay_status
tools.description: GatePay service status: health, route-auth configured state, active policy summary, mock-settlement state and ledger integrity. Free; moves no money.

tools.name: gatepay_policy
tools.description: The active GatePay routing policy: live rail/network, per-transaction and daily caps, settled-per-hour limit, target allowlist state and the 50 bps fee. Free; moves no money.

tools.name: gatepay_quote
tools.description: Quote a payout: runs the same policy evaluation POST /v1/route would, returning allow/deny, the reasons and the fee split. Settles NOTHING and writes NO ledger entry.

tools.name: gatepay_route
tools.description: Execute a payout through the existing GatePay route logic (same caps, allowlist, ledger and Arc settlement path as POST /v1/route). Executes ONLY when the MCP HTTP request carries the X-GatePay-Route-Key header; a missing or wrong key is a hard refusal before any policy, ledger or settlement step ru
